text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to lock speaker confirmations + rehearsal times for next week's webinar. Topic is 'Practical inference patterns for production: batching, caching, and graceful failovers'. Can everyone check availability by EOD?

Dan: I'm good. prefer Tue/Thu rehearsals after 2pm PT.

Kevin: Ops note — need a 30m window with infra team to test model routing + fallback smoke tests. Tue morning works for me.

Sarah: Can we finalize the public abstract today? Draft below — feedback welcome: 
'Join Redwood engineers to learn pragmatic strategies for serving LLMs in production. We'll cover batching, prefix/KV caching, cost vs latency tradeoffs, and building graceful fallback paths. Includes a short demo and troubleshooting checklist.'

Maya: Nice draft. Suggest adding target audience line: 'for platform and ML engineers running inference at scale'.

Lucy: Speaker ops checklist: 
- Final speaker bios (one-liners + headshot)
- Slides due 48h before event
- Demo playbook (steps + failover plan)
I'll collect bios by EOD.

Alex: I'll own the demo playbook and create a minimal runbook for the infra test. Will post in this thread when ready.

Dan: Q&A routing — recommend 2 buckets: product questions -> Sarah, infra/runtime questions -> Kevin. Anything developer-onboarding -> Dan.

Maya: Agreed. Also setting up a dedicated inbox to capture inbound leads from registration form. @Lucy can you confirm the routing to SFDC?

Lucy: Yep — routing rule: tag source=webinar, assign lead_owner=Marketing_Growth. Demo interest flagged -> create task for Solutions Eng. I'll add Kevin as watcher for infra requests.

Kevin: For the smoke test we need: 
```
- endpoint: staging.redwood.internal/model-proxy
- test payloads: short/long seq distribution (1, 64, 512)
- simulate capacity drop -> expect fallback to smaller quantized model
- measure p50/p95 latency pre/post caching
```
I'll run this during the infra window.

Maya: Run-of-show (first pass): 
1) 00:00–00:05 Welcome + goals (Maya)
2) 00:05–00:20 Pattern 1: batching & micro-batching (Dan)
3) 00:20–00:35 Pattern 2: prefix/KV caching + cache invalidation (Sarah)
4) 00:35–00:50 Demo: routing and graceful failover (Kevin + Alex)
5) 00:50–00:05 Closing + CTA + lead capture reminder (Maya + Lucy)
6) 00:55–01:00 Live Q&A (all)

Lucy: Small note — demo needs a fallback script in case the staging endpoint spikes. Alex?

Alex: I'll build a scripted fallback: if primary fails, switch to quantized-1.3b variant and show latency diff. Will keep logs capturing token counts and error traces.

Dan: Rehearsal requests: 
- dry run 1 (content flow) — Thu 3pm PT (30m)
- full run (with infra smoke) — Mon 9am PT (45m)
Can everyone confirm?

Maya: Thu 3pm OK for me. Mon 9am might conflict with timezone folks — Kevin can you do 9?

Kevin: I can do Mon 9 for infra.

Sarah: Thu 3pm works.

Lucy: Booked both slots in calendar + included external link to the rehearsal doc.

webinar-bot: Reminder: slides deadline set to 48 hours before event. Attachments can be uploaded to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/inference/webinars/practical-inference

Maya: Great progress — final asks before EOD:
- Sarah: update abstract with audience line
- Lucy: confirm SFDC routing rule + share contact for onboarding task
- Alex/Kevin: post demo playbook + infra test checklist in this thread
- Dan: short bio + one slide with key takeaways

Dan: Will drop bio + slide by 5pm PT.

Sarah: Abstract updated and pushed to the doc.

Kevin: Infra checklist posted (see code block above) and I'll attach test logs after smoke test.

Alex: Demo playbook uploaded to drive and linked in calendar invite.

Lucy: SFDC rule confirmed and owner assigned: Marketing_Growth.

Maya: Thanks team — I'll do a final pass tomorrow morning and send the public registration copy. :rocket:
